result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where metadata text overlaps under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text elements overlap each other, making both unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the flex/row layout or spacing between the delivery time and delivery fee labels (e.g., add proper horizontal spacing or wrap them in a non-overlapping container) so they render side by side cleanly.
